description: This PHP class 'LocationService' provides methods for managing location data within the OrangeHRM system, including retrieval, search, normalization, saving, and deletion of location entities.

classes.name: LocationService
classes.description: Service class for handling location-related operations such as retrieval, search, normalization, saving, and deletion within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getLocationDao
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the LocationDao instance.

methods.name: getLocationById
methods.description: Retrieves a Location entity by its ID.

methods.name: searchLocations
methods.description: Searches for locations based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchLocationListCount
methods.description: Returns the count of locations matching search criteria.

methods.name: getNumberOfEmployeesForLocation
methods.description: Returns total employees in a specific location.

methods.name: getLocationIdsForEmployees
methods.description: Gets location IDs for given employee numbers.

methods.name: getAccessibleLocationsArray
methods.description: Returns an array of accessible locations, optionally for a specific employee.

methods.name: saveLocation
methods.description: Saves a Location entity to the database.

methods.name: deleteLocations
methods.description: Flags locations as deleted based on IDs.

methods.name: getLocationsArray
methods.description: Retrieves all locations and normalizes them into an array.
